q: What are the emissions of scrapping a car at a vehicle scrapping centre?
title: Vehicle scrapping centre per vehicle
short: The biggest risk is the AC refrigerant: if it escapes instead of being recovered, it is the centre's Scope 1 at a high global warming potential. Add electricity for cutting, balers and shredders, and diesel for handling. Divide by vehicles scrapped. Steel and aluminium sold go to recyclers and mills.
audience: Registered vehicle scrapping facilities and fleet owners

ul: Refrigerant recovered vs released, from recovery logs.
Electricity per vehicle at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh.
Waste oil, coolant and batteries sent for treatment.

p: Scrapping is end of life for your own vehicle, Category 5 waste if you pay for it.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
